result:
I found no blocking issues in candidate `4265b71`. The diff changes only four files, all on the allowlist, and the unit and load suites pass when run as a normal (non-root) user. I have two minor advisory notes.

```
VERDICT: PASS
CANDIDATE: 4265b71501958ce30407eebc76ebe2b638f0a186
FINDING addr-dup-collapse advisory: Email to/cc are now compared as sets (engine.py:91-95, frozenset), so a source list that differs only by a repeated address (e.g. "a@x;a@x" vs stored "a@x") is treated as equal and not written. There is no security impact, and EspoCRM keeps only one copy of an address anyway. | evidence: _address_set builds a frozenset of the trimmed, lower-cased parts | expected: none required; optionally say in IMPORT.md that duplicate addresses are ignored
FINDING single-read-transport-error advisory: the new long-text single read uses client.get, which raises TransportError("read_failed") on a non-200 response (api.py:97-99), the same way the existing CRM-008-F phone read already does. More records can now reach that path (every record with a 10,000-char prefix). The handling and exception codes are unchanged. | evidence: engine.py:414-429 calls _single -> client.get | expected: none for this WO; worth knowing for A2
EVIDENCE:
- git -C worktree rev-parse HEAD = 4265b71501958ce30407eebc76ebe2b638f0a186 (matches the candidate). git status --porcelain was empty at the start and still empty after testing; all runs used a copy in $TMPDIR.
- git diff --stat base..candidate: docs/IMPORT.md, load/lib/crm_load/engine.py, tests/load/fixtures.py, tests/load/test_load.py, all on the allowlist. mapping.py is untouched. There are no dependency, CI, hook, container or vendored file changes. One commit.
- gitleaks git --log-opts="c3c0fef..4265b71" --redact: "no leaks found", rc=0. Grepping the diff for passwords, tokens, keys, IPs and real-domain emails found nothing. The test addresses are synthetic *.test / example.test only. No customer data.
- No non-GET added on the comparison path: the only new request is client.get, which is GET {Entity}/{id} and is counted in reads (api.py:93-100). There is at most one per record: the `single` dict cache is created per upsert and shared with _phones_same (engine.py:356, 373, 414-418, 442). There are no new list reads, so no unbounded read.
- Create body, update/WriteRejected handling, retries and exception codes are unchanged. Email usersIds is skipped only in the update branch (engine.py:357-360). The create body is still built from all attributes (engine.py:343).
- Truncation rule: a value is re-read only if the listed value is exactly 10,000 chars, the desired value is longer, and the listed value is a prefix of it. Otherwise the compare and write happen as before. A missing attribute in the single read means a write (the safe default).
- Tests added: no subprocess, socket, eval, pickle, chmod or network calls.
- Load suite: python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t . -> Ran 223 tests, OK. Unit suite: -s tests/unit -> Ran 561 tests, OK. uid=1002 (non-root).
- Mutations in the copy (load suite): CREATE_ONLY={} -> 35 failures; truncation re-read disabled -> 3; to/cc set comparison disabled -> 35; case-insensitive from disabled -> 36; prefix check dropped -> 1.
```
